declarations.name: todoPens
declarations.description: Pen colours: the tick, the strike line, icons and a task's text. Each background maps them to readable inks.

declarations.name: todoHighlights
declarations.description: Highlighter colours for a task's background, mixed into the list's own background so they suit every theme.

declarations.name: todoBackgrounds
declarations.description: Background presets of the customize panel. `default` follows the component's CSS variables and the theme.

declarations.name: todoPalettes
declarations.description: Colour palettes: each sets the six highlighters and the five pens, in a light and a dark variant.

A to-do list with the feel of a paper one: tasks are plain text, checked off with a hand-drawn tick (or cross) and
a pen stroke through the text. Progress shows as a ring beside the heading, a bar, or a large hero ring. Click a
task to add a note, drag a row to reorder it, and swipe it left to archive or delete it or right to check it (the
swipe and the reordering come from `c2-reorder-list`). The row's ⋯ menu (also a right-click, and the keys N, I, X,
E and Delete) holds the same actions plus the task's icon, highlighter and text colour, each changed in place.
Archived tasks collect in a section at the bottom, and every removal can be undone.

With `customizable`, a palette button swaps the tasks for a panel that styles the whole list: the background
(whose text colour and pens follow from it), the pen, the done mark, the density and the progress style. With
`storage-key` those choices are remembered in `localStorage`.

The swipe actions are drawn by the inner `c2-reorder-list`: recolour them with its
`--c2-reorder-list__swipe-action__{warning,danger,success}--background-color` variables, set on this element.

members.name: headingLevel
members.description: Heading level (1-6) the title is announced with.

members.name: icon
members.description: Icon beside the heading, a `@c2n/task-icons` name. Suggested from the heading when missing; `none` shows no icon.

members.name: tasks
members.description: The tasks. Accepts a JSON array in the attribute. The list updates it as the user works.

members.name: progress
members.description: How progress is drawn: a ring beside the heading, a bar under it, a large ring above it, or not at all. The viewer's choice in the customize panel wins.

members.name: customizable
members.description: Shows the palette button and its customize panel, where the viewer styles the whole list.

members.name: storageKey
members.description:
Remembers the viewer's customization in `localStorage` under `c2-todo-list:<storage-key>`. Give every list on a
site its own key.

members.name: persistTasks
members.description: With `storage-key`, also remembers the tasks, which then win over the `tasks` the page provides.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Tasks cannot be checked, added, reordered, swiped, removed or edited. The look can still be customized.

members.name: placeholder
members.default: 'Add a task — a note after a dash'

members.name: look
members.description: The viewer's customization. Set it to apply a look from script; the panel and `storage-key` keep it up to date.

members.name: darkSurface
members.description: Whether the default background turned out dark (a dark theme), which picks a palette's dark variant.

members.name: resetLook
members.description: Forget the viewer's customization and return to the authored look.

members.name: handleDocumentEscape
members.description: Escape closes an open menu or icon picker wherever focus is, e.g. after a menu opened on hover.

events.name: look-change
events.description: The viewer changed the look in the customize panel, or reset it.

events.name: tasks-change
events.description: Fired after every change to the tasks with the new list, for two-way binding.

events.name: task-reorder
